nodes.label: --max-iterations bounded repair cap
nodes.rationale: A hard cap on repair/edit cycles prevents an unbounded automatic LLM repair loop; after the cap only human approval is offered.

nodes.label: html_engine (declarative Python HTML document engine)
nodes.rationale: Kept dependency-light and declarative so printable documents can be composed from a component tree; PDF export via WeasyPrint is optional rather than required.

nodes.label: LabelValue component
nodes.rationale: Exposes a separate value_attrs dict so editing attributes land on the inner value <div> rather than the outer label/value container.

nodes.label: Arbitrary HTML attributes (attrs) passthrough
nodes.rationale: Emitting an arbitrary attrs dict verbatim lets layout builders attach contenteditable and data-field to value elements without the engine knowing anything about editing, keeping the engine generic.

nodes.label: contenteditable + data-field editable value convention
nodes.rationale: Every data-bearing field carries its own data-field path so the rendered HTML is directly editable in a browser and the same path keys feed human corrections back through apply_edits — one identifier serves rendering, editing, and correction.

nodes.label: Dotted field-path notation (plots.0.plot_no)
nodes.rationale: Variable-length list rows need addressable identity; dotted indices give each repeated cell a stable key into the extracted data dict.

nodes.label: Citizenship layout builder
nodes.rationale: Uses coordinate/absolute positioning because citizenship certificates are rigid single-page forms with fixed field placement.

nodes.label: Laal Purja layout builder
nodes.rationale: Uses flow and table layout instead of absolute positioning because land records have a variable number of plot rows and Devanagari numerals per document.

nodes.label: information_extraction (OCR extraction and schema registry)
nodes.rationale: Builders receive only clean schema-validated fields; missing or uncertain values stay explicit rather than being invented at render time.

nodes.label: LangGraph controller StateGraph
nodes.rationale: Wires extraction, building, verification and human review into a single bounded stateful loop so the pipeline can iterate without unbounded automatic retries.

nodes.label: generate_resources node (v2 stub)
nodes.rationale: Deferred to v2: raising NotImplementedError for unknown document types keeps v1 honest, while the eventual node would have an LLM emit a layout module plus schema so the pipeline becomes self-extending.

nodes.label: controller/schema_patcher.py
nodes.rationale: Patches are written to <schema_name>_patched.json and the original schema is never modified, so repairs are reversible and the hand-authored schema stays authoritative.

nodes.label: LangGraph interrupt/resume human-in-the-loop pattern
nodes.rationale: interrupt() surfaces the review payload to whatever caller drives the graph, so a terminal CLI, a web API, or any other frontend can supply the decision without changing graph code.

nodes.label: MemorySaver checkpointer
nodes.rationale: Persists state across interrupt/resume cycles; documented as swappable for SqliteSaver when durable sessions are needed.

nodes.label: Annotated[list[dict], add] history reducer
nodes.rationale: History entries are appended rather than overwritten so every loop iteration is retained as an audit trail.

nodes.label: Browser-based visual editor (future work)
nodes.rationale: The contenteditable + data-field attributes already emitted on every value element are the groundwork, so the editor can be added as pure JS without touching the Python layout code.

nodes.label: WeasyPrint PDF export
nodes.rationale: Kept an optional extra dependency; base_url must be passed so relative image paths resolve during PDF generation.

nodes.label: Default HTML escaping policy (RawHTML / escape=False as opt-out)
nodes.rationale: Text components escape by default so untrusted OCR output cannot inject markup; RawHTML is the explicit trusted-markup escape hatch.
nodes.norm_label: default html escaping policy (rawhtml / escape=false as opt-out)

nodes.label: Constrained patch vocabulary (design choice)
nodes.rationale: The LLM may only propose changes from a fixed vocabulary (add_field, modify_field, add_header_field, etc.) and cannot emit raw HTML, CSS, or Python. Trade-off: gives up expressiveness in exchange for a bounded, auditable, non-arbitrary-code-execution repair surface.
nodes.community_name: Controller — Document Verification, Repair & LangGraph Pipeline

nodes.label: Original files untouched — patches write to _patched.json
nodes.rationale: Schema patches are written to a sibling _patched.json rather than mutating the source schema, and the existing layout builder is reused as-is. Keeps every automated repair reversible and keeps the hand-authored builder as the single source of layout truth.
nodes.norm_label: original files untouched — patches write to _patched.json
nodes.community_name: Controller — Document Verification, Repair & LangGraph Pipeline

nodes.label: LangGraph interrupt() with MemorySaver checkpointer
nodes.rationale: Human review is expressed as a LangGraph interrupt with a MemorySaver checkpointer so the identical graph can be driven from a CLI, a web API, or any other frontend without code changes — the frontend choice is deliberately kept out of the graph definition.
nodes.community_name: Controller — Document Verification, Repair & LangGraph Pipeline

nodes.label: Bounded iterations (max_iterations)
nodes.rationale: max_iterations (default 3) prevents infinite repair/edit loops; once the budget is spent only 'approve' remains available, forcing termination rather than unbounded LLM retry spend.
nodes.community_name: Controller — Document Verification, Repair & LangGraph Pipeline

nodes.label: Append-only state history
nodes.rationale: Every iteration's verification result and human decision is appended to state["history"] via LangGraph's add reducer, chosen so the loop is fully traceable after the fact instead of only exposing final state.
nodes.community_name: Controller — Document Verification, Repair & LangGraph Pipeline

nodes.label: Contenteditable HTML output with data-field attributes
nodes.rationale: Rendered HTML carries contenteditable="true" plus data-field="field_name" on every extracted value element (e.g. owner_name, plots.0.plot_no), with dashed-blue hover and solid outline + yellow focus affordances. Chosen so a plain browser is a usable correction UI with no app shell, and so edits map unambiguously back onto extraction-schema field paths.
nodes.norm_label: contenteditable html output with data-field attributes
nodes.community_name: Controller — Document Verification, Repair & LangGraph Pipeline

nodes.label: Planned visual editor
nodes.rationale: Future work — drag-and-drop field reordering, resize handles, add/remove fields, live text sync back to the extraction schema. Deliberately routed through the same apply_edits graph node so the visual editor adds no second write path into the schema.
